newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Mayr-Melnhof to buy R.J.Reynolds plant.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Mayr-Melnhof to buy R.J.Reynolds plant.

text.p: Europe's leading cartonboard manufacturer Mayr-Melnhof said on Wednesday it had reached a preliminary agreement to buy a printing plant of U.S. cigarette maker R.J. Reynolds (RJR) in Germany.

"This new long-term partnership with one of the world's most important cigarette producers takes us into the specialised high quality cigarette packaging segment," Alfred Fogarassy, deputy chief executive of Mayr-Melnhof said in a statement.

RJR's plant in Trier, Germany, would continue to deliver printed cigarette boxes for brands such as Camel and Winston to RJR international factories throughout Europe under a long-term supply agreement, the statement said.
"This further acquisition by Mayr-Melnhof Packaging Division marks an important step in achieving the Group's strategy of internal and external growth in the packaging sector," the statement said.
High quality packaging was expected to contribute to an improvement in the group's profit margins, it added.
"We see opportunities for further expansion, particularly in Eastern Europe," Fogarassy said. The company also plans to expand production in Trier. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
